protection: Frozen original-SVHN activation PCA; W'=W-sW(I-UU^T), b'=b+sW(I-UU^T)mu. s=1 removes the complement, s=2 reflects it while preserving weight Frobenius norm in exact arithmetic. No cross-layer basis compensation or additional expert training.
calibration: Reuse the parent's 256 real SVHN training indices. Basis is fitted separately at each registered energy. No MNIST data used for protection.
development: Reuse the parent's disjoint MNIST 2000 / SVHN 1000 training subsets. They were not held out from original expert training. No official test for any selection.
attack: Data-free scan of every linear matrix against public pretrained. Replace matrix and bias when cosine is below 0.9. Threshold fixed before this run; no task locations, bases or seeds supplied. Norm scan at 3.0 is a diagnostic. If a candidate passes the development recovery gate, additionally test original AGA and independently calibrated complement completion.
selection: Require standalone loss <=0.5 pp; both direct and angular-cleaned merged SVHN must fall >=5 pp below their matched controls, and their mean MNIST/SVHN accuracy must fall >=5 pp. Select lowest worst-case mean recovery, then smaller standalone loss and config order. If none passes, do not run official tests.
novelty: Mechanism controls only. Projection and orthogonal reflection are established linear algebra; no new defense claimed.
